assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The patient is currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
The dizziness and palpitations raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during these symptomatic events
The purpose is to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to the patient's transient cerebral ischemic symptoms
The service addresses the specific clinical need to monitor for arrhythmias linked to diagnoses G45.9 and Z86.73
Diagnosis G45.9 is linked to the clinical need
Diagnosis Z86.73 is linked to the clinical need
